headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Krishna Collector suspends nine officials over poll duty absences.
All set for second phase panchayat polls across South A.P.
Ensure victory of NDA-backed candidates in second phase of panchayat polls.
Villagers protest as wild elephants continue to roam.
Keralam govt. issues order reconstituting endosulfan cell.
bullets_ur: Krishna Collector ne nau afsaron ko poll duty se ghaib rehne par muallaq kar diya
South A.P mein panchayat intikhabat ke doosre marhalay ki tamam tayyariyan mukammal hain.
Panchayat intikhabat ke doosre marhalay mein NDA ke hami ummeedwaron ki jeet yakeeni banayein.
Jangli hiyon ki musalsal aawajawi par gaon walon ka ehtijaj.
Keralam hukumat ne endosulfan cell ki tashkeel-e-nau ka hukoomi aadesh jari kar diya.
